summary: The text argues for parental autonomy in education technology use, advocating for opt-out options for children when technology use is deemed unnecessary. It emphasizes the importance of providing parents with meaningful alternatives to digital learning methods and the right to choose non-digital educational options for their children.

claims.requested_action: Provide opt-out options for technology use
claims.argument: Parents should have the right to opt their children out of unnecessary technology use in school and receive an equivalent, meaningful, non-digital educational alternative.
claims.evidence_quote: Parents should be able to say: For my child, I want the non-digital version of this educational experience.
